summary: Mission-producing steps can declare a run-scoped child ID with ${ST_MISSION_RUN}, isolating consent and review missions between runs.

replay.detail: Existing literal output IDs are unchanged. Run-scoped IDs resolve deterministically from the durable producer run ID and its pinned mission revision.

schema.detail: Adds the optional per_run_missions marker to the closed mission.published claim schema. No database layout, client-v0 schema or codegen changes.

compatibility.detail: All active members must advertise per_run_missions=1 before publication. Older replicas retain marked revisions as unknown claim fields rather than selecting a shared literal output ID.

manual.detail: Upgrade or fence every replication peer before publishing run-scoped outputs. Produced missions still require explicit retirement.

recovery.detail: Retain a supporting build while run-scoped producers are active; downgraded builds cannot select their marked revisions.
